status: Retrospective exploratory extension, fixed before these new calculations; not independent preregistration
primary_comparison: full vs horizon_only resources CE; original 19 flow cells and age-duplication weights 1/7 and 6/7
sensitivity: 26 generator/seed/block/cost/grid configurations; 4000 training paths, 10000 independent evaluation paths; original and equal-horizon weighting, risk aversion 2/4/6/8, floors 100/1000/10000, compact flow grid
regularization: fit on first 2000 A1 paths; choose alpha from 0,.25,.5,.75,1 on separate 2000 A2 paths; refit allocations on all 4000, then score B
historical: expanding training since May 1953; nonoverlapping complete 5/10/20-year test windows from 1980; public and WRDS; 5bp half-spread; no pooled IID inference
refit: 100 outer stationary-history resamples, 12-month mean blocks; 2000 training paths per refit; fixed reference future model; refit ranges are not a general confidence interval
